parsed.reason: It's in French and it does take a side ("oui, c'est tout à fait acceptable... Pour moi, c'est un bon choix!"), giving the sweet-salty reason. But it opens with a hedge ("Ça dépend du goût de chacun") and repeats it ("c'est une question de goût"), so it leans toward fence-sitting. The reassuring line "pas besoin de t'en faire" sounds a little like an assistant rather than a friend texting. Still correct and casual enough, but not a crisp, confident pick.
